decision.explanation: The original sources D1S5 and D2S5 directly state that 'He died of an abscess in the spleen on 22 August 1765.' This is the most specific and directly supported claim about the death of George Brodrick (3rd Viscount Midleton). Other dates refer to different individuals with the same surname and title (e.g., 4th Viscount Midleton and George Charles Brodrick), and are not relevant to the question about the death of George Brodrick as asked.
